webhook-retry-local-note (operational / episode)
layer: warm   visibility: local
recorded: 2026-10-06 18:31 · 4m ago

Our webhook receiver retries failed deliveries three times with a short
backoff. Beyond that, deliveries are dropped and logged.

arguments.name: webhook-receiver-hardened
arguments.body: Hardened webhook/receiver.py and documented configuration: removed hardcoded signing secret in favor of WEBHOOK_SIGNING_KEY (fail closed), require timestamp-signed HMAC by default with five-minute replay window, validate exact bytes/hex signature, cap body at 1 MiB, and use configurable exponential backoff with jitter/retry classifier. Delivery idempotency via durable provider event-ID dedupe remains the caller's responsibility. No tests were run.
